rootCause: The autosave feature wrapped the complete multi-query Client GET in a 5-second interactive transaction, but kept getFamilyLinksForClient on the outer Prisma client. With one available pool connection, tx holds the connection while awaiting an outer query that requires another connection. The outer query waits until the transaction expires, and subsequent tx custom reads / catch fallback read fail with P2028. Sequential relation reads also exceed the same interactive lifetime under transport latency even with spare connections.

proofAndLimits.confirmed: Exact accepted feature route reproduces P2028 on real PostgreSQL with connection_limit=1 and no network delay; stable main and fixed route return 200 under identical constraints. Spare connections remove the fast failure. Artificial DB transport latency reproduces timeout with spare connections too.
proofAndLimits.productionPoolConfiguration: Not read or changed. Production logs prove transaction expiry and final stack; no per-query/pool-wait trace was present, so the precise production balance of pool contention versus transport latency cannot be retroactively measured.
proofAndLimits.localQAMissed: Original isolated DB used a fast local transport and a pool with spare connections. No connection_limit=1 / slow transport case existed; spare-connection before route succeeds in 78 ms.
proofAndLimits.requestDisconnect: Normal open request reproduces 500/P2028. Aborting the synthetic HTTP client at 100 ms also leaves server handler running until P2028 at ~5 seconds. Production browser received HTTP 500, while Vercel independently logged Prisma expiry; no evidence attributes the incident to user internet.
proofAndLimits.queryMetrics: Prisma query events count SQL statements including BEGIN/SET/COMMIT/ROLLBACK, plus the real access-scope User read. Middleware durations additionally include connection acquisition wait. Synthetic auth replaces JWT lookup; timings are isolated handler measurements, not production performance claims. Extra slow-path SELECT is a pool/control read.
